scope: Delivered finite single-ASIC model evidence; no main-spec synchronization, archival or hardware accuracy claim.

requirements.boundary: Configurable effective FC/matmul work, dtype/rates and positive quanta; numerical tensors and ISA execution remain unsupported.

requirements.title: Loads and stores generate memory traffic
requirements.boundary: Remote LOAD/STORE uses actual admitted memory traffic; local stages share declared L1 service.

requirements.title: Bounded producer-consumer buffer semantics
requirements.boundary: Finite FIFO A/B/C bundles have one physical owner and safe generations; not the full TT-Metal circular-buffer API.

scenarios.name: Producer outruns consumer

requirements.title: Reader compute writer overlap follows dependencies
requirements.boundary: Reader/math/writer overlap follows dependencies and shared service; no detailed unpack/pack engine model.

requirements.boundary: Explicit FC-chain sidecar only; 7-D/4-D features and four-coordinate root actions retained. New heterogeneous predictor/RL training is not delivered.

requirements.title: Single-ASIC identity and scope
requirements.boundary: Exactly one selected ASIC; no board-wide capacity aggregation or interchip execution.

requirements.title: Configurable hardware parameters with provenance
requirements.boundary: Units, sources and override history remain explicit; assumptions are not calibrated device facts.

requirements.title: Physical layout and enabled compute are distinct
requirements.boundary: Physical routers and aliases survive harvesting; the example enabled mask is explicitly assumed, not inferred from a worker count.

requirements.title: Explicit compatibility and feature support
requirements.boundary: Admitted replay adapters execute; the general full-profile legacy scheduler remains gated. Optional model inference is unvalidated.

requirements.title: Initiators and transaction paths
requirements.boundary: Actual requests, target service, responses and local writes; addressed replay is an aggregate memory abstraction.

requirements.title: Packet overhead and segmentation are executable
requirements.boundary: Executable physical headers/padding/software segmentation; automatic NIU splitting and linked forms remain unsupported.

requirements.title: Shared memory capacity and service
requirements.boundary: One capacity owner and combined FIFO service per physical resource; no per-bank/channel/cache precision.

Both fabrics target one local memory resource

requirements.title: Completion, readiness, and ordering are explicit
requirements.boundary: Handoff, effects, replies, versions and fences have explicit scopes; timestamps and list order do not imply global ordering.

scenarios.name: A consumer follows an asynchronous write

requirements.title: Existing DMA contracts remain distinguishable
requirements.boundary: Legacy DMA issue/slots/datapaths/commands remain distinct; adapters do not add addressed visibility or duplicate LSU cost.

scenarios.name: Legacy and Wormhole transfers use shared transport

requirements.title: Scalar synchronization has resource cost
requirements.boundary: Initialized monotonic increment-by-one counters and serviced local threshold/data waits; no reset/decrement/CAS, tensor reduction or general semaphore API.

scenarios.name: Producers signal one consumer

requirements.title: Canonical heterogeneous directed topology
requirements.boundary: One canonical directed graph; export does not establish compatibility with a mesh-trained checkpoint.

requirements.boundary: Configurable dimensions and fabric transforms/order; the initial profile uses an explicit assumed enabled mask.

requirements.title: Bounded flow control and justified deadlock prevention
requirements.boundary: Dateline/classes and finite draining endpoints justify the model; no literal silicon VC encoding or liveness under permanent failure is claimed.

scenarios.name: Admissible traffic drains through cyclic physical topology

requirements.title: Trace and failure identity is preserved
requirements.boundary: Faults select one enabled directed fabric edge; legacy paired-link behavior and versioned traces retain their separate contracts.

requirements.title: Multicast uses shared network delivery
requirements.boundary: Real shared nonwrapping corner-rectangle trees; no arbitrary destination masks, multicast reads/atomics or literal hardware reservation encoding.

requirements.title: Claims identify their evidence tier
requirements.boundary: Architecture/model checks are present; no compatible external functional capture or silicon measurement was supplied.

requirements.title: References and run conditions are reproducible
requirements.boundary: Source/input bytes, units, layout, clocks, seed and conditions are explicit; unknown metadata blocks stronger comparisons.

requirements.boundary: Historical child gates are reviewed at delivery revisions; fresh checks are labeled separately. Pre-harness validation was not deferred.

requirements.boundary: Predeclared metrics and sealed fit/held-out mechanics execute with synthetic fixtures; no measured parameter calibration is claimed.
